ei.title: The Hidden Costs of Explicit Instruction
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: The assumption that just being more explicit will make for better instruction assumes that language is simply a delivery system for information, a literal packaging of knowledge. It is not. Each utterance in a social interaction does much more work. For example, there are hidden costs in telling people things. If a student can figure something out for him- or herself, explicitly providing the information preempts the student's opportunity to build a sense of agency and independence, which, in turn, affects the relationship between teacher and student. Think about it. When you figure something out for yourself, there is a certain thrill in the figuring. After a few successful experiences, you might start to think that figuring things out is something that you can actually do. Maybe you are even a figuring-out kind of person, encouraging an agentive dimension to identity. When you are told what to do, particularly without asking, it feels different. Being told explicitly what to do and how to do it — over and over again — provides the foundation for a different set of feelings and a different story about what you can and can't do, and who you are. The interpretation might be that you are the kind of person who cannot figure things out for yourself. This is doubtless one reason why recent research has shown that most accomplished teachers do not spend a lot of time in telling mode.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ affect → affects: 주절 주어가 동명사 providing(단수)이므로 동사는 3인칭 단수 affects가 와야 한다. ← 정답
det.analysis:
✅ ① assumes: 주어 The assumption(단수)에 대한 3인칭 단수 동사로 올바른 어법
✅ ② providing: 조건절 내에서 동명사 주어 'explicitly providing the information'이 문장 주어 역할을 하며 올바른 어법
❌ ③ affect → affects: 'which, in turn, affects the relationship'에서 주절의 동사는 동명사 주어 providing에 호응하는 단수 동사 affects가 와야 함. affect는 수 일치 위반
✅ ④ encouraging: 앞의 완전한 절 뒤에 분사구문으로 부가 설명하는 현재분사로 올바른 어법
det.tip: 동명사 주어(V-ing)는 단수 취급합니다. providing → affects로 수 일치.

det.korean: ① Told → Being told: 수동 의미의 동명사 주어이므로 Being told가 와야 한다. ← 정답

❌ ① Told → Being told: 문장 주어 자리에서 '지시받는 것'이라는 수동·진행 의미의 동명사구가 필요하므로 Being told가 올바름. 과거분사 Told만으로는 주어 역할 불가

✅ ② to build: 'opportunity to build'에서 to부정사가 opportunity를 수식하는 형용사적 용법으로 올바른 어법
